o.text: Of Mongolic origin. Ultimately from Proto-Mongolic *tala, *tal-b- (“steppe, open place”), whence also Modern Mongolian тала (tala).
Borrowed from Russian ми́тинг (míting), derived from English meeting.
Inherited from Old Anatolian Turkish آلم صاتم (alım satım). Antonymous compound of alım + satım. Literally, "buying and selling".
Morphologically, from dərin (“deep”) + düşüncə (“thought, thinking”) + -li. Probably a calque of Russian глубокомы́сленный (glubokomýslennyj).
